name: Movements
description:
'''Movements''' are an American [[post-hardcore]] band from [[Rancho Santa Margarita, California]], formed in 2015.

The band was signed to a record contract with [[Fearless Records]] after playing just one show in 2015. They have released an EP, ''[[Outgrown Things]]'' (2016), and four albums, ''[[Feel Something (Movements album)|Feel Something]]'' (2017), ''[[No Good Left to Give]]'' (2020), ''RUCKUS!'' (2023), and Happier Now (2026). ''Feel Something'' peaked at 190 on the [[Billboard 200|''Billboard'' 200]] chart.
